Soprano (C1), mezzo-soprano (C2) and baritone (C5) clefs are not supported: lilylet CLEF_SHAPES has only treble/bass/alto/tenor (and G/F/C), and an unknown name is encoded as treble with a warning. The image exists to show which letters sit on the lines of these clefs (soprano C4 E4 G4 B4 D5, mezzo A3 C4 E4 G4 B4, baritone B2 D3 F3 A3 C4). Writing them in alto clef would keep the pitches but put them on the wrong lines, which would mislead, so no file was written.
